scope: Auth claim stub; real PostgreSQL RLS/RPCs, not hosted Supabase/load testing

checks.name: 15 accounts enroll; account 16 is rejected
Re-enrollment is idempotent
Unconfirmed accounts are rejected
Anonymous reads and RPC execution are denied
Private keys and helper functions cannot be accessed
Own profile is readable; another user sees no rows
Direct table writes and role escalation are denied
Quotes need the server signing key
Cross-account execution cannot read or spend a quote
Approval and confirmation are both enforced
Retry returns the receipt with a single debit
Expiry uses database time
Risk and per-transfer limit are enforced in SQL
Daily limit is enforced across different quote IDs
Frequency limit is enforced at execution
Viewer and planner permission tiers are enforced
Insufficient balance rolls back without receipt
Global AI allowance is bounded across users
Per-user and global daily AI allowances are enforced
Audit export is own-account only and detects event changes
Deleting another account does not affect the owner document
Schema can be reapplied without deleting user data
Owner full account deletion cascades profiles and ledger, releasing an enrollment slot
